LESSON: PASSING INFORMATION ON TIME

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.2: Passing information on time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Passing information on time, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: What do you do before coming to school? 2. What do you do on the days we do not come to school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
